Google.WordList:CLI.behavior: Suppress the Google substitution when CLI is clear in context or occurs in an official product name.

Google.WordListCase:content-type.behavior: Treat content type as approved Syllago domain terminology.

Google.Contractions.behavior: Do not fail CI merely because a contraction is possible. Ask whether a contraction improves naturalness without changing literal or formal text.

Google.Semicolons.behavior: Discard non-prose spans deterministically. Jev may suppress strongly supported conjunctive-connector or complex-series exceptions. Closely-related-clause exceptions remain review-only; otherwise retain the Vale alert.

Google.Passive.behavior: Report passive voice only when it hides an actor or responsibility the reader needs to act or troubleshoot.
